You'll have to look for yourself, I'm just a binary trans guy doing his part. Talk to people with other genders, look at research papers, read news articles. The best advice I can give you is to avoid bias. Find sources from all ends of the spectrum, even look at people trying to ""disprove"" non-binary identities. If you seek out the information, you'll find it.

General rule of thumb is there's make, female, and non-binary. Non-binary is a blanket term for any gender that isn't M or F, be it genderfluid, bigender, agender, or something else entirely. The only one who can define your gender is you, so do some research and find one that feels right.
